problems: Status: done. Neither assigned file existed when this run resumed, so both were written from scratch. The guide specs/05-wm/ui-implementation-guide.md is complete and covers all six parts of the task: the component inventory for primitives, shell, overlays, login, apps and boot; the compositor/Solid split for window open, close, minimise and maximise using WAAPI; the kernel wiring; 13 vertical slices mapped to P2/P3/P4 and requirement IDs; the asset pipeline and budgets; and the test plan. The checklist docs/design/ui-checklist.md is complete, with per-screen, per-element, per-state and per-animation ticks and the reduced-motion outcome for each animation.

The design sources contain no Stitch output. Every generate call timed out on 2026-09-24. The folders hold hand-built reference.html and reference.png files, not screen.html and screenshot.png. files-light and files-semantic-search have notes only and no render. The guide and checklist treat the references as the visual target.

Several points in the user's design direction contradict normative specs. The guide records each one as a decision (D-01 to D-25) and sends a cross-spec request. The owners must approve them: the atom logo against the identity spec's ring mark and its ban on 'glowing' and gradients (PLT-ID-16); the self-hosted Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts against DSN-06; glass and gradients against DSN-01; the menu bar and dock replacing the taskbar and tray (DSN §3.8.7, WM §3.10–3.11); the violet accent replacing orbit blue; and tokens living in ui/src/tokens instead of wm/tokens.

The Stitch notes include looping animations and spinners: login wallpaper drift, halo breathing, the About orbit rotation, the speculative hatch loop, shimmer loops and spinners. These break DSN-07 and WCAG 2.2.2. The guide overrides them (D-08, D-09), and the checklist lists what to build instead.
The agent-confirm-sheet design is a second way to answer the destructive-plan confirmation, which conflicts with C12 and DSN §3.8.15. It is blocked until an ADR approves it (D-14).
A parallel agent built a Spinner primitive (ui/src/primitives/spinner). It conflicts with DSN-07 and UIG-07. The guide forbids its use on any Plotinium screen and leaves removal as an open question.
ui/README.md and ui/src/primitives/index.ts cite specs/05-wm/visual-language-macos.md, which does not exist.
ui/src/tokens/tokens.css is 5.0 KB gzip, over DSN-10's 4 KB budget. motion.css still hard-codes durations as calc(ms * var(--pl-k)) instead of named tokens.
The editor-conflict and task-manager-processes reference renders draw the identity spec's ring mark, not the atom logo.
All 24 docs/design/stitch/*/notes.md files fail prettier --check. These are not my files, but CI format:check would flag them.

The protocol does not yet have several things the UI needs: tty.ack is missing from CALL_NAMES; NetStatus has no retryAt or in-flight op count; there is no window.setCloseGuard, perf.frame topic or outbox listing; there are no compositor-port messages for pref, svc.retry, net.retry, notify.action or apps; login.* router messages and create.kind 'palette' are missing. All are listed in guide §4.9 and §9.2.
